description: Groz Ring Slogging Wrench| Ideal for tightening and loosening large nuts & bolts in ship maintenance and other industrial applications |Forged Chrome Vanadium Steel Construction| Size: 41mm|RSW/41 - Distributed/Packaged by Groz. Product Details: Groz Ring Slogging Wrench is ideal solution for tightening and loosening rusted and painted nuts and bolts in in ship maintenance, mining, piping and other similar industrial applications. It is manufactured from forged chrome vanadium steel which imparts high strength and toughness which enables it to withstand high fatigue and wear. Hardened and tempered body makes it strong enough to withstand continuous blows of hammer, making it durable.
